purpose: Provide privacy-safe JSON-stdio hook transport normalization, provider schema validation, and diagnostic receipts without embedding product-specific policy.

runtime_boundary.privacy: Transport receipts persist raw-byte hash, length, encoding, and top-level keys only; payload values are not persisted.

non_goals: own prompt registries or prompt semantics
decide whether P07 or any other prompt should execute
claim malformed Cursor input without a captured receipt
persist raw prompts, attachments, or session identifiers in diagnostic receipts
proof_ceiling: Synthetic tests can prove parser/schema behavior. A live Cursor receipt is required to attribute a workstation transport failure to Cursor.
